title: HTML
tagline: Semantic document architecture, accessible forms, media APIs, and modern web standards.
description: Master HTML5 from foundational document structure and semantic landmarks through accessible form engineering, responsive media, ARIA patterns, microdata SEO, and native browser elements like dialog and popover.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a web browser and text editor
whatYoullLearn: Author valid, accessible HTML5 documents with proper landmark hierarchy
Build keyboard-friendly forms with native Constraint Validation API attributes
Optimize responsive images with srcset, sizes, picture, and lazy loading
Apply WCAG AA semantics, ARIA roles, live regions, and focus management
Use modern native elements including dialog, details, template, and popover
Structure metadata, Open Graph tags, and JSON-LD for search engine indexing

levelSummaries.Beginner: Document anatomy, headings, semantic landmarks, links, lists, and core text markup.
levelSummaries.Intermediate: Accessible forms, validation attributes, responsive media, tables, and embedded content.
levelSummaries.Advanced: WAI-ARIA engineering, native interactive dialogs/templates, performance hints, and structured SEO.

projectTitle: Accessible Developer Conference Landing & Registration Page
